title: Port Security Camera Investigation
description: The image on the right comes from a security camera overseeing a port. Note: For the sake of privacy, you only need to provide the bottom half of the license plate containing 2 sets of numeric values, formatted as: [XX]-[XX].

questions.label: Find the license plate of the vehicle highlighted in orange.

hint: Take a look at the sign on the building (相澤水産) and search for this organization's website.
